before.title: Tenure-Track and Teaching-Track Faculty
before.summary: The department lists open tenure-track faculty hiring with an emphasis on Systems this year, plus a teaching-track faculty search for core undergraduate and master's courses. No deadline is stated on the page.

after.title: Faculty Positions: All Tracks 2027
after.summary: School-wide search across all SCS departments for tenure, research, systems and teaching faculty; the CSD hiring page emphasizes Systems. All materials due December 16, 2026; LTI teaching applicants encouraged to apply by October 23 for an early review.

before.title: The SCS Mark Stehlik Postdoctoral Teaching Fellowship
before.summary: One-year, renewable teaching fellowship for recent PhDs, considered across all SCS departments; applications accepted at any time with reviews each spring.

after.title: The SCS Mark Stehlik Postdoctoral Teaching Fellowship
after.summary: One-year, renewable teaching fellowship for recent PhDs, considered across all SCS departments; applications accepted at any time with reviews each spring.

before.title: Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering - Faculty Positions (Pittsburgh)

after.title: Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering - Faculty Positions (Pittsburgh)
after.summary: Tenure- and teaching-track positions at all ranks in all areas of electrical and computer engineering. Applications are considered throughout the academic year.

before.title: Postdoctoral Teaching Fellowship in Electrical and Computer Engineering
before.summary: Teaching-focused postdoctoral fellowship for recent PhDs in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or closely related fields, starting fall 2027. Potentially renewable up to two years in total.

after.title: Postdoctoral Teaching Fellowship in Electrical and Computer Engineering
after.summary: Teaching-focused fellowship for recent EE, CE, CS or related PhDs, beginning Fall 2027 and potentially renewable up to two years total. Review begins immediately and continues until filled or March 31, 2027.

before.title: 2026-27 INI Teaching Track and Non-Tenure Track Faculty Positions
before.summary: Primarily teaching-track faculty at all levels in information networking, information security, AI engineering, and mobile/IoT engineering. Doctorate in computer engineering, EE, CS or related field preferred; applications reviewed until filled.

after.title: 2026-27 INI Teaching Track and Non-Tenure Track Faculty Positions
after.summary: Primarily teaching-track faculty at all levels in information networking, information security, AI engineering, and mobile/IoT engineering. Doctorate in computer engineering, EE, CS or related field preferred; applications reviewed until filled.

before.title: Post Doctoral Fellow - Learning Technologies and Augmented Reality

after.title: Post Doctoral Fellow - Learning Technologies and Augmented Reality
after.summary: Postdoc in the HCI Institute on AI-assisted intelligent-tutoring authoring and a mixed-reality teacher support tool. Requires a PhD in learning technologies, HCI, educational data science, or a related field.

additions.department: Institute for Computer-Aided Reasoning in Mathematics (ICARM)
additions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Institute for Computer-Aided Reasoning in Mathematics (ICARM)
additions.summary: Two-year fellowship beginning August 2027 on AI and formal methods for mathematics, with technical support duties in place of teaching. Requires mathematics or closely related PhD and ML/formal-methods expertise; applications considered until filled.

additions.title: Full-Time Tenure Track Faculty Member
additions.summary: Search in biomedical AI or immunoengineering, generally at assistant rank with senior candidates considered. Still officially listed and open until filled, but full-consideration date remains November 16, 2025.

additions.title: Open-Rank Faculty Search in Civil & Environmental Systems Engineering
additions.summary: Open-rank search in systems engineering methods such as optimization, decision science, multi-agent systems and simulation for civil/environmental applications. Relevant PhD required; review begins November 15, 2026 and continues until a candidate is identified.

additions.title: Assistant Professor, NeuroAI
additions.summary: Neuroscience/AI search welcoming CS, ML, robotics and related PhDs, with substantive neuroscience connection required. July 1, 2027 start; November 1, 2026 full consideration, then open until filled.

additions.title: Teaching Track Faculty Position in Neurotechnology (Assistant Professor)
additions.summary: Full-time teaching faculty for the neural technologies master’s program, supervising capstone projects and teaching interdisciplinary neurotechnology. CS and robotics PhDs are explicitly eligible; neuroscience/engineering background and teaching experience required.

additions.title: Post Doc (CLeaR)
additions.summary: Two one-year postdoctoral fellowships in causal learning and inference, beginning October 2026 and potentially renewable. CS, philosophy, statistics or closely related PhD required; no application deadline stated.

additions.title: Faculty Position in Entertainment Technology
additions.summary: Assistant/associate teaching faculty in games and interactive entertainment, including code reviews and project supervision, beginning Fall 2027. Relevant MS/PhD preferred with five or more years of industry experience; equivalent extensive professional experience considered and review continues until filled.

additions.title: Tenure-track position in Mathematical Sciences - Computational Mathematics (AY27/28)
additions.summary: Open-rank computational mathematics search including optimization, mathematical foundations of ML/AI, AI for mathematics and numerical analysis. Mathematics or closely related PhD; September 1, 2027 start, review from November 15, 2026 until filled.

additions.title: Post Doctoral Fellow
additions.summary: Postdoc on PLUS and the National Tutoring Observatory, researching tutor training, matching and AI-assisted support with educational data analysis. CS, information systems, cognitive/learning science or related PhD; no application deadline stated.

additions.department: Ray and Stephanie Lane Computational Biology Department
additions.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate - Pfenning lab
additions.summary: Postdoc applying machine learning to genomic signals and cell-type-specific regulation in the Vertebrate Genomes Project. Bioinformatics or related PhD and experience analyzing genomic data with ML required; no deadline stated.

additions.department: Ray and Stephanie Lane Computational Biology Department
additions.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate - Xu lab
additions.summary: Multiple postdoc roles using computer vision and machine learning to analyze cryo-ET 3D images. CS, EE, computational biology or related doctorate; still officially listed with a 2022 opening date and no deadline stated.

additions.department: Ray and Stephanie Lane Computational Biology Department
additions.title: The Lane Fellow
additions.summary: Computational/biological sciences fellowship remains officially listed, but its stated three-year appointment begins around August 1, 2024 and doctorate eligibility uses 2023–2024 dates. March 1, 2024 full consideration, with other applications considered case by case; applicants should confirm current availability.

additions.title: Post-Doctoral Associate
additions.summary: Two postdocs applying computational social science, agent-based modeling and social network analysis to online harms and influence campaigns. STEM PhD, programming and quantitative analysis experience required; no deadline stated.

additions.title: Professor and Department Head of Mechanical Engineering
additions.summary: Department head search requiring an internationally recognized research/leadership record and eligibility for a tenured full professorship in engineering or closely related science. Department expertise includes robotics and AI/ML; review from August 3, 2026 until filled, with expected January 1, 2027 start.

additions.title: Teaching-Track Faculty Position (2026-2027 Hiring Cycle)
additions.summary: Teaching faculty integrating AI/ML into mechanical engineering education, typically assistant rank with higher ranks considered. Relevant PhD and teaching/mentoring excellence required; November 1, 2026 full consideration, with immediate review.

additions.title: Tenure-track position in Mathematical Sciences - Mathematical Finance (AY27/28)
additions.summary: Mathematical/computational finance search preferring promise in stochastics, machine learning and computing; mathematics, statistics or closely related PhD required. September 1, 2027 start; review from November 15, 2026 and continues until filled.
